values.products-description:
A short loop of black bridle leather riveted around a blackened steel split ring. It hangs from a belt loop or a bag strap and keeps your keys from scratching everything else in the pocket.

The ring opens with a thumbnail and holds up to eight keys. The rivet is solid copper, peened by hand, and will not work loose.

A small thing, but the one you touch most days.

products-image1.products-image1-alt: Black leather key loop with a dark steel ring

products-spec.products-spec-care: Condition the leather when it looks dry
products-spec.products-spec-material: Bridle leather; blackened steel; copper rivet

values.products-subtitle: A leather loop and a blackened ring that keep keys quiet.
